name: 6sense
tagline: 6sense is an AI-powered B2B revenue platform that uses intent data, predictive analytics, and account identification to reveal which accounts are actively researching your solution. Its AI prioritises target accounts by buying stage, enabling sales and marketing teams to engage the right accounts at the right time with personalised outreach.
